# Catalogue Parameter table descriptions


## CATALOGUE_DEFAULTING

This table is an internal table used by  PowerCARD  to manage defaulting of some tables' fields created upon marketable catalog products validation.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.  (

identifies the Primary Key of this table)

|   Seq. | Column Name           | Data  Type   |   Len. | Sc.   | Column Description                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|--------|-----------------------|--------------|--------|-------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|      1 | ENTITY_NAME           | VARCHA R2    |     60 |       | Entity name.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|      2 | FIELD_NAME            | VARCHA R2    |     60 |       | The field name that will be defaulted.                                                                                                                                                                   |
|      3 | PRODUCT_TYPE          | CHAR         |      1 |       | The catalog product type. Possible values are: 'P' = Payment instrument, 'A' = Account, 'N' = Loan, 'Y' = Loyalty, 'I' = PAN auxiliary product, 'C' = Account auxiliary product, 'R' = Product services, |
|      4 | DATA_ORIGIN           | CHAR         |      1 |       | This column indicates if its value will be defaulted by a static value or a dynamic value that is not  present in the XML. Possible values are: 'S' = Static, 'D' = Dynamic.                             |
|      5 | FIELD_VALUE           | VARCHA R2    |     60 |       | The field value in case DATA_ORIGIN = 'S' (Static).                                                                                                                                                      |

|      5 | FIELD_VALUE           | VARCHA R2    |     60 |       | The field value in case DATA_ORIGIN = 'S' (Static).                                                                                                                                                      |
|      6 | DYNAMIC_VALUE_S OURCE | VARCHA R2    |     60 |       | The dynamic values source to be used in case DATA_ORIGIN = 'D' (Dynamic), it contains a variable  name that will be managed in the service.                                                              |
|      7 | USER_CREATE           | VARCHA R2    |     15 |       | ID of the user when record created.                                                                                                                                                                      |
|      8 | DATE_CREATE           | DATE         |      7 |       | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                                                                                           |
|      9 | USER_MODIF            | VARCHA R2    |     15 |       | ID of the last user who modified the record.                                                                                                                                                             |
|     10 | DATE_MODIF            | DATE         |      7 |       | Date and time when the last record modification occurred.                                                                                                                                                |

## CATALOGUE_IDENTIFIERS

This table is an internal table used by  PowerCARD  to manage identifiers generation that will be used as PK of some tables created upon catalog marketable products validation. For example CARD_FEE_CODE field of 'CARD_FEES' table in case of payment instrument products.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.

Columns description


|   Seq. | Column  Name     | Data  Type   |   Len. | Sc.   | Column Description                         |
|--------|------------------|--------------|--------|-------|--------------------------------------------|
|      1 | IDENTIFIER_C ODE | VARCHAR2     |     60 |       | The unique code identifies the identifier. |

|   2 | PRODUCT_TY PE   | CHAR     |   1 | The catalog product type. Possible values are:                                                                                  |
|-----|-----------------|----------|-----|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|   4 | PREFIX          | VARCHAR2 |  10 | The prefix to be added in case the column's length is greater than the SEQ_LENGTH column defined in the  'CATALOGUE_SEQ' table. |
|   5 | SUFFIX          | VARCHAR2 |  10 | The suffix to be added in case the column's length is greater than the SEQ_LENGTH column defined in the  'CATALOGUE_SEQ' table. |
|   6 | USER_CREATE     | VARCHAR2 |  15 | ID of the user when record created.                                                                                             |
|   7 | DATE_CREATE     | DATE     |   7 | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                  |
|   8 | USER_MODIF      | VARCHAR2 |  15 | ID of the last user who modified the record.                                                                                    |
|   9 | DATE_MODIF      | DATE     |   7 | Date and time when the last record modification occurred.                                                                       |

# CATALOGUE_MAPPING

This table is an internal table used by  PowerCARD  to manage the mapping between XML's tags and tables' fields. It's used upon marketable catalogs validation.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.


# Columns description

|   Seq. | Column Name   | Data Type   |   Len. | Sc.   | Column Description                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|--------|---------------|-------------|--------|-------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|      1 | ENTITY_NAME   | VARCHAR2    |     60 |       | The entity name.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|      2 | FIELD_NAME    | VARCHAR2    |     60 |       | The field name to be mapped to an XML tag.                                                                                                                                                               |
|      3 | PRODUCT_TYPE  | CHAR        |      1 |       | The catalog product type. Possible values are: 'P' = Payment instrument, 'A' = Account, 'N' = Loan, 'Y' = Loyalty, 'I' = PAN auxiliary product, 'C' = Account auxiliary product, 'R' = Product services, |
|      4 | TAG_ID        | VARCHAR2    |     60 |       | The tag ID in the XML representing the field.                                                                                                                                                            |
|      5 | USER_CREATE   | VARCHAR2    |     15 |       | ID of the user when record created.                                                                                                                                                                      |
|      6 | DATE_CREATE   | DATE        |      7 |       | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                                                                                           |

|      6 | DATE_CREATE   | DATE        |      7 |       | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                                                                                           |
|      7 | USER_MODIF    | VARCHAR2    |     15 |       | ID of the last user who modified the record.                                                                                                                                                             |
|      8 | DATE_MODIF    | DATE        |      7 |       | Date and time when the last record modification occurred.                                                                                                                                                |

## CATALOGUE_PRODUCT

his table is used to bundle the different categories of issuing product (Payment instrument, Account product, loan product,….etc) that can be used to constitute a catalog and align them with the needs of each institution.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.

Possible values are: 'D' = Deprecated, 'M' = Maintenance, 'O' = On going, 'V' = Valid, 'R' = Rejected, 'S' = Suspended,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.

|      5 | USER_CREATE      | VARCHA R2    |     15 |       | ID of the user when record created.                                                                                                                                                                      |
